A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VA-GS research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of all dimensions.

before.justification: v1 reports original VA-GS reconstruction and novel-view synthesis results on DTU, Tanks and Temples, Mip-NeRF 360, and Deep Blending, together with ablation experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results and ablation experiments in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same Gaussian representation, single-view and multi-view alignment components, five loss terms, and optimization objective.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same reconstruction and novel-view synthesis tasks using DTU, Tanks and Temples, Mip-NeRF 360, and the Deep Blending scenes in Appendix B.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding tables and figures, including the Gaussian-based and implicit reconstruction baselines. No comparison method is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Section 5 and the appendices retain identical scene selections, splits, metrics, preprocessing, training budgets, and ablation controls, including 15 DTU scenes, six TNT scenes, and the Mip-NeRF 360 one-in-eight evaluation split.

E4.justification: Section 5.2 and Appendix C retain the same loss ablations, source-view counts, patch sizes, initialization alternatives, smoothing thresholds, and runtime analyses in Tables 4, 7, and 8.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative results match across Tables 1–8 and Figures 1–8. For example, VA-GS retains mean DTU Chamfer distance 0.49, TNT F1-score 0.54, and Table 3 average PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS of 27.50/0.837/0.174.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 and their associated definitions, assumptions, and derivations are unchanged. No mathematical argument or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about improved geometric representation through view alignment and state-of-the-art reconstruction and synthesis performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations and qualifications remain identical, including Appendix D's discussion of feature alignment and PGSR, and Appendix E's limitations concerning camera poses, sparse views, scalability, and pretrained features.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, loss weights, training schedules, RTX 4090 hardware disclosure, baseline-result provenance, and the source-code link are unchanged. The added funding identifier supplies no technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, reference list, and positioning relative to prior methods, including PGSR in Appendix D, are identical.

P1.justification: v2 adds grant number 2682025CX109 to the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities acknowledgment. The arXiv margin stamp changes from v1 dated 13 October 2025 to v2 dated 26 November 2025; the remaining prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All eight figures and eight tables retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. The stamp and acknowledgment text updates introduce no layout reorganization; all other pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 only supplies a funding identifier and updates the arXiv stamp. The scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and presentation structure—including all appendices—remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
